newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Unibud shares for public trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Unibud shares for public trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared 1.59 million shares of construction firm Unibud SA, including an initial public offering of up to one million shares, KPW chairman Jacek Socha told a news conference on Thursday.
Unibud wants to issue 500,000 shares in the large investor tranche due on January 27-31, where investors can register for at least 21,000 shares.
In the small investor tranche Unibud offers 500,000 shares from January 20-31. In this tranche investors can subscribe for no fewer than 10 and no more than 20,000 shares.
The issue will be valid if investors subscribe for at least 700,000 shares.
The company, which is 49.99-percent owned by Budimex had a net profit of 1.3 million zlotys on 44.1-million-zloty-sales last year.
